svg.text: SHARED REUSABLE TRANSFER FLEET · TRANSFER GEOMETRY · DOCK DETAIL · VOLUME III · SHEET 1 OF 5

g.text: A TUG THAT JUST DELIVERED DOES NOT
RETURN EMPTY IF SOMETHING NEEDS BRINGING DOWN.
FIG. B — ONE POOL, TWO TEMPERAMENTS
NEITHER DOMINATES. THE POOL CARRIES BOTH:
SPEED FOR THE URGENT, THRIFT FOR THE BULK.
CRYOGENIC PROPELLANT BOILS OFF AND WILL NOT
SETTLE IN A TANK WITHOUT GRAVITY.
A TUG THAT CANNOT BE REFUELLED IS JUST AN
EXPENSIVE SINGLE-USE STAGE WITH EXTRA STEPS.
AND AGREEMENT IS SLOWER THAN ENGINEERING.
1 — TUG + PAYLOAD: no wings, no heat shield, no legs — it never leaves vacuum
2 — BURN 1: raise the far side of the orbit · 3 — Δv, the price of every task
4 — DEPOT: refuel rather than discard — the pivot the whole concept turns on
5 — THE POOL: dispatched against a queue, sized to aggregate demand, owned in common

g.text: LAND · REENTER · CARRY A HEAT SHIELD
